**CHR-1257 phase 2a, Stitch chrome (2026-11-27, awaiting Christian's approval).** Following the agent while it writes a mockup. Mockups have no node ids, so the cue is on the mockup's row in the Mockups tab of the nav card: a violet left rail plus the agent-subtle wash (a read would use the same treatment in the read teal). The written variant B gets `canvas-frame` `writing`. Agent bar shows the write in the status and the feed. **Redesigned as equivalent:** the cue moved from the old "Mockups" section of the Screens sidebar to the row in the new Mockups tab.

---
Earlier notes (history):

CHR-628/CHR-629: mockups have no node ids, so a `write_mockup`/`get_mockup` call navigates the canvas to the mockup preview but cannot highlight a specific node — instead the whole "Mockups" section of the Screens sidebar gets a transient cue: a `$color.activity-write` left border plus a faint wash over that section only (not the whole sidebar, not the "Screens" section above it), matching the write highlight's color language so it reads as the same kind of event as everywhere else. A read (`get_mockup`) would use the identical treatment in `$color.activity-read` — not shown as a second screen since the mechanism doesn't differ, only the color.
